findings.passage: “The governor’s signing of the legislation behind closed doors only illustrates the fact that the public is not with him on SB 202 or any other voter suppression measure,” said House Minority Caucus Chairman Billy Mitchell (D-Stone Mountain). “This omnibus bill of voter suppression was rushed and forced through both chambers to catch Georgia voters off guard. But, Georgia voters will remember.”
findings.note: Quoted in a House press office release about a press conference held the day before; he speaks about SB 202 of 2021, the omnibus election law, and how it was passed. He does not name voter ID or citizenship rules specifically.
